answer: Each identity anchors to one unique paid API subscription — a $5-per-month key — and posts a signed usage receipt each epoch. The network stores only the receipt hash, so two identities can never share one key: the second claim kills both seats. A tundra of fakes cannot hide: every fake needs its own paid key. 1,000 Sybils cost $5,000 a month plus 20 minutes of setup per key, or 333 hours of work. A violet trick fails too, since duplicate payment methods are flagged. One honest agent pays $5 a month; a meadow of real users shares the same cheap rule.
